subject: Great meeting at ML Systems Summit - follow up on inference needs
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@edgeai.co>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Great meeting at ML Systems Summit - follow up on inference needs

Hi Daniel -

Really enjoyed our conversation at the ML Systems Summit last week. You mentioned EdgeAI is looking to standardize low-latency inference for multi-region customers and evaluate options for dedicated vs hosted deployments. I pulled together a short one-pager (attached) that highlights how Redwood approaches: dedicated capacity, routing policies, and cost controls (batching + quantization).

Quick recap of what I heard:
- Low-latency inference (~<120ms p95) for edge/regional tenants
- Need for predictable cost and SLA for a 3rd-party vendor
- Interest in private/VPC deployment for regulated clients

If that sounds right, would love to schedule a 30-min discovery call to map requirements and share a rough TCO comparison. I have availability:
- Wed 8/5 10:00-11:30 PT
- Thu 8/6 13:00-15:00 PT
Or feel free to pick a time: https://cal.com/marissa/redwood-intro-30

Attaching the one-pager and a stub pricing sheet. Happy to tailor the deck before our call.

Thanks -
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-one-pager.pdf

Hi Daniel -

Just bumping this in case it got buried after the conference. If now isn't the right time, totally understand - could you share whether this is a Q3 or Q4 priority for EdgeAI?

If helpful, Aditya (cc'd) can put together a quick side-by-side of Dedicated vs Hosted capacity for your typical throughput (you mentioned ~200 concurrent sessions).

Thanks -
Marissa

Hi Daniel -

Quick one-line follow: do you want me to hold off and check back in Q4, or is a 15-min sync this month easier? Happy to be flexible - I want to make sure we're not pinging at the wrong cadence.

If timing has shifted, just let me know when's best to circle back.

Cheers,
Marissa

From: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@edgeai.co>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Great meeting at ML Systems Summit - follow up on inference needs

Hey Marissa -

Sorry for the radio silence - we've been heads down on a Q3 product push and this got deprioritized. I appreciated the one-pager you sent. We're unlikely to make a vendor decision in Q3; planning to evaluate inference vendors starting in early Q4.

Could you send over a ballpark pricing range for both Hosted and Dedicated for an initial shortlist (roughly 200 concurrent sessions, bursty traffic, multi-region)? If you can include the one-pager + pricing in a single doc, I'll circulate to the platform folks and keep Redwood on the shortlist.

If anything changes on our side and we can meet before Q4, I'll reach out.

Thanks,
Daniel Kim
Head of Platform Engineering | EdgeAI
daniel.kim@edgeai.co | (617) 555-0189
